ctx.x: No, we used to make it too, at all. I don't know. We'd make it, put it up, and have to leave it for four or five days, then you go to put it in your bottle. You get a cap, then after you put it in the bottle, you leave it there for about... Well, some folks leave it for a day, and then they go to say, light the cap to that evening to drink it.
Somebody told me once that Shots, did you know Shots Madison or Kid Shots? That was a, he used to sell homebrew. That was his main job, I think, during Prohibition. Yeah. But Fess told us. Yeah.
Well, you know, Kid Ernest was in that sometimes too.
